docs(skill): rewrite test-expert for the single-node fork (it was a verbatim operator copy) (#31)

node-template's test-expert was a near-verbatim copy of the operator monorepo's:
'in this monorepo', nodes/<node>/app paths, pnpm -F <node>, multi-node stack/
isolation, the cogni-operator-test app, DoltHub test orgs, the env-e2e node-
formation lane, poly/resy examples — almost none of which exist in a flat single-
node fork. It described a dozen commands the fork doesn't have (test:meta,
test:contract, test:arch, test:stack, check:fast, arch:check, check:docs). A node
author following it was actively misled.

Rewritten against this node's REAL surface (verified, not assumed):
- CI = exactly static / unit / component; stack/external/money are local-only.
- Real scripts only: pnpm test, test:component, test:external, test:external:money,
  check, db:check, typecheck. No invented commands.
- Flat app/ paths; pnpm --filter @cogni/node-template-app, not -F <node>.
- Drops operator-only scaffolding: env-e2e/node-formation, multi-node, cogni-
  operator-test, DoltHub orgs, poly/resy, coverage-dial, tests/lint, e2e/Playwright.
- Keeps the universal value: layer-picking, never-mock-the-DB, the dotenv-CWD trap,
  skip-gate ordering, component-as-RLS-gate (links schema-update).

This is the source fix; it propagates to forks via the same path as the other
skills (manual until the fork-sync webhook lands, bug.5036). Closes the last
known toothless skill in the node-template audit.

feat(knowledge): adopt DELETE_IS_CLEAN — delete op, not soft-deprecate (#38)

Port of Cogni-DAO/cogni#1730. Replaces the contribution `deprecate` op (which
set status='deprecated' — write-only cruft nothing reads) with a `delete` op:
DAG-safe (409 if still cited; cascades own outbound edges), hard-deletes the row.
Dolt history preserves content + commits + attribution. Keeps node-template in
lockstep with the operator standard (no node should set the 'deprecated' standard).

fix(conductor): derive auth root from git, not a personal cogni-template path (#40)

AUTH_ROOT hardcoded $HOME/dev/cogni-template as its final fallback, so on any
node other than the operator apex the setup script symlinked the wrong checkout's
.env.cogni (wrong creds + var names) over the node's own and aborted with
'exists and is not a symlink'.

Derive the canonical (main) workspace from git — a Conductor spawn is a worktree
of it — so there is zero hardcoded or personal path and never a reach into an
unrelated repo. Keep a pre-existing real .env.cogni instead of clobbering it, and
guard the link/refresh helpers against an empty or self-referential root.

feat(conductor): sync worktree branch to latest main on setup (#41)

refresh_workspace_base_ref only updated the origin/main tracking ref; the
checked-out branch stayed behind whatever stale local base Conductor formed the
worktree from. Add sync_workspace_to_base (the 'git pull main' step): merge the
freshly fetched origin/main into the current branch. Conflict-safe — skips on a
dirty tree or detached HEAD, and aborts + warns on a merge conflict instead of
wedging the worktree.

feat(auth): port candidate-auth-bootstrap (CDP-attach storageState capture) to node-template (#42)

The authed-Playwright bootstrap lived only in cogni-template + the operator
monorepo, so node-template forks (e.g. beacon) had no way to populate .local-auth
and drive authed candidate-a flows. Port it so every fork self-serves:

- scripts/dev/capture-authed-state.mjs: connects to a CDP-debuggable Chrome and
  exports storageState to .local-auth/<slug>.storageState.json (no signin, no CI).
- docs/guides/candidate-auth-bootstrap.md: the MetaMask + dedicated-profile + CDP
  capture runbook, de-coupled from cogni-template (generic <node> slugs, no
  internal tracker refs).
- @playwright/test devDependency: required by the capture script's connectOverCDP.
  Attaches to the human's running Chrome, so no browser download is needed.

Closes the node-repo auth-bootstrap gap noted across beacon work.
